title: DeepSeek unveils ‘Super-agent’ design to handle multiple tasks in parallel and improve efficiency
summary: DeepSeek unveils Super-agent design to handle multiple tasks in parallel
detailed: Chinese AI startup DeepSeek announced a "Super-agent" design to handle multiple tasks in parallel and unveiled the open-sourcing of its internal inference framework, DeepInfer.
DeepSeek's large language model V4.1-Flash-1017 recorded 33.6 trillion tokens in weekly usage between October 19 and Sunday.
The startup reportedly plans to expand its latest funding round to as much as 100 billion.
This matters for developers and efficiency as DeepSeek scales its architecture, open-sources tooling, and manages high token volumes.
